From merit and fairness to reforms, inclusion and technology, it traces how UPSC has evolved alongside India while remaining committed to selecting talent for public service. candidate_claims.text: One such major, historic achievement of India is set to mark its 10th anniversary in just a day – this achievement is the ‘Surgical Strike’.
Ten years ago, on September 28-29, 2016, the Indian Army carried out surgical strikes on terrorist hideouts in Pakistan.
It was in this very month of September – specifically on September 13, 2008 – that many innocent lives were lost in the serial blasts in Delhi.
Just a few weeks later, the massive 26/11 attack took place in Mumbai.
Friends, This year also marks 25 years since the 9/11 terrorist attacks.
Among the innocent lives lost at the World Trade Center in the US, the highest number of victims—after Americans – was Indians.
